reviews.text: At the Milan office I met friendly people.

I've never seen an association run like this.
Disorganized and lazy.
They send you a message saying the pedigree is ready for pickup, and then you're left empty-handed because the offices aren't coordinated at all.
Worse than state-run organizations.
Change jobs and commit to being more serious.
ENCI office in Milan

It's never possible to speak to the staff. They never answer the phone. I hope I never need this place again.

Since the Milanese Canine Group was placed under special administration and the Milan Delegation was created in the ENCI offices in Viale Corsica, finding parking is practically impossible, a nightmare 🙃 …
I was waiting for a message to go and collect the pedigree... But it never arrived...

We're below zero!! I'm calling for pedigrees, and as always, I'm getting fewer than the litter number. You call repeatedly and they hang up or put you on hold, ultimately to no avail. SHAMEFUL
SHAME!!!!

Being in the spotlight on the RAI 3 program Reportage didn't help him at all. I purchased a German Shepherd from a breeder in Caserta. The documents show different dates of birth, and the dog was microchipped in October. The dog has been in Tuscany since September, and then developed serious health problems right from the start. I reported it to the Italian National Association of Dog Breeders (ENCI), which is their responsibility, but nothing... one star because it's the best you can get... and I'd add, "We humans aren't taken into consideration, much less do they care about the well-being of dogs."
It's the dog handlers' organization. Some of the staff could be more empathetic and polite, but they're the minority. I'm fond of this place.
A special thanks to the very kind Diana! Efficiency and kindness combined are uncommon!

It feels like entering a luxury hotel, very beautiful.
The staff are friendly and fast.
The cost for a Pedigree is 25 euros.

The ENCI website is beautiful, colorful and well-designed.
But does the ENCI exist, or is it just a bank account where I pay all my membership fees like a fool?
For over 20 days, I've been calling and emailing for simple information, but nothing, absolutely nothing. I'd give it 0 stars, but it's a shame you can't.

She helped me with everything, very kind.
I also had my stallion's pedigree picked up three weeks ago, but it wasn't there yet. She reprinted it for me at the office.
I swear, it's truly the best!
Thank you so much!

I've been trying to contact them for a month because they got the shipping address wrong, and no one answers. They leave me on hold for half an hour or more, and then they hang up. Kudos to you for your professionalism and organization.

Scandalous, where did it get lost in the land of toys???

I don't feel like I'm being taken for a ride anymore!!!
The breeder has contacted me countless times, but to no avail. I've sent email after email, called, and nothing!!!
You're pitiful!

An office stuck in the Middle Ages. Of the four people in line ahead of me, none of them managed to complete the process due to bureaucratic quibbles. They don't have email addresses and only accept in-person signatures. I'm only open for three hours in the morning, three times a week. I wonder if they'll accept half a kilo of coarse salt when I have to pay.
